comments.author: Frank Harrigan
comments.content:
Hi

Will there be a Linux version of Quest?

I was hoping to run Quest on Linux Mint, sending my files via my Windows PC via Evernote so that I can work on the text adventure during my lunch break on my netbook.

Thanks

comments.author: Alex Warren
comments.content:
Maybe eventually - Quest is written in .net, so it could be run on Linux using Mono. However, the UI would need rewriting for Linux, as Mono doesn't support WPF.

I'm currently working on a web version of the Editor, which may be more useful for you - no need to use anything to transfer files, just log in with any browser and work on your game. Hopefully this will be available in a few months.
